snippet.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City | Full Launch Trailer | VR
snippet.description:
Get behind the bandana as the iconic heroes in a half shell, stalking the sewers, streets, and rooftops as Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello, or Michelangelo in the first-ever Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles game that takes YOU inside the shell in virtual reality.

The Foot have taken New York by force. But with infighting and an unlikely ally, you might just be up to the task. Forge your own chapter in TMNT legacy solo or with up to four players cooperatively. Hone your skills with the brothers’ signature weapons and slash, swing, and stab your way through combat as you land precision strikes, block crushing reprisals, and evade the killing blow.

-----
